title: Trump Supporters Storm the US Capitol
dek: A mob halts Congress's count of Joe Biden's win for hours; Mike Pence declares the result before dawn on 7 January.
body: Rioters injured 174 police officers. Congress finished the count before dawn, and Pence declared Biden the winner, 306 to 232.

panels.label: Trump Says
panels.text: Trump calls it “a day of love”; his pardon order says it “ends a grave national injustice.”

panels.label: His Critics Say
panels.text: McConnell calls Trump “practically and morally responsible”; Biden says the mob “held a dagger at the throat of America.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side says the state punished his supporters, the other that he tried to keep power he lost; at stake is who certifies a US election.
